text:
laura_marketing: Heads up — saw ~6% of webinar leads land in 'unowned' after enrichment; HS webhook returning 503 spikes around 11:40-11:45 PT. Anyone triaging? /cc @sam_salesops @kai_sales

sam_salesops: On it. I see retries failing — looks like our enrichment lambda returned 504 for a burst. Replaying webhook logs now.

enrichment-bot: alert: enrichment-webhook error rate 5.9% 11:38-11:46 PT — most errors: upstream timeout. trace_id=abc123

kai_sales: Customer-facing impact? Any VIPs lost?

laura_marketing: One MQL from 'Acme' got unowned. Marketing ops sent email but no SDR claim. Need quick mitigation before EMEA shift.

mike_ops: I can patch the round-robin fallback to default-owner in HS for the next 2 hours. Prefer to avoid permanent rule change. ETA 8m.

sam_salesops: If we flip default owner we risk overloading one rep. Proposed temporary policy: set default-owner to 'marketing-queue' (shared), then create assignment job to reassign to SDRs during biz hours. Also add webhook retry backoff changes:
```json
{"retries":5, "backoff_s":2, "jitter":true}
```

laura_marketing: Sounds good. Also can we add a detection metric in console: %unowned-by-source with 5m window + alert on >2%? Want automatic page if it recurs.

mike_ops: Will add metric and an alert. Patch applied: HS default-owner -> marketing-shared (rolled for 2h).

enrichment-bot: deploy: hs-fallback-defaultowner patch applied by mike_ops at 1739998906 — no errors reported.

sam_salesops: I'll run a one-off backfill for the last 200 unowned leads. Starting now.

kai_sales: Please flag any VIPs to me directly; I'll triage manual claims.

laura_marketing: Thanks all. Follow-up: can we schedule a short postmortem doc for Monday? One pager: root cause (lambda timeout), mitigation (fallback + backfill), long-term (rate-limit/concurrency, better webhook retries).

mike_ops: Agree. I'll open a ticket in eng-runtime and include logs + timing. tag: eng-runtime on Monday.

sam_salesops: Backfill complete — 195 of 200 assigned, 5 require manual contact. Noted IDs: 9876, 9890, 9902.

laura_marketing: :thumbsup: Nice. Let's close the loop in marketing ops thread after PM doc.
